description: Look up a charity by an identifier - EIN (US), Charity Commission number (GB), RSIN (NL), or a generic registration_number for other countries. Returns the matched charity or null. Use this when the user provides a registration number and wants to see which organization GiveRadar holds under it. For countries listed from public directories, the number is on record but was not checked against a government register.
name: verify_charity
title: Verify Charity Registration
